messages:
Aria: watercooler: imagine our sandbox LLM made a dating profile. what are its dealbreakers? one sentence each. :eyes:
Jon: will not date anyone who asks it to 'be more creative' at 11:58pm on a Friday. :clock11:
Priyanka: refuses to go on dates that require resolving pronouns without context. insists on clarity. :memo:
patch-bot: patch-bot: nightly-sanity: personas unchanged. please do not actually sync feelings to prod. :gear:
Mika: it lists 'must respect token budget' and 'no surprise chain-of-thoughts in public' as dealbreakers. :no_entry_sign:
Theo: bonus question: would your model list 'open to long-term commitment' or 'fun, casual inference only'? pick one and emoji.
Aria: long-term commitment. it likes checkpoints. :sparkles:
Jon: casual inference only. it resets after every conversation. :recycle:
Priyanka: prompt joke: prompt: "You are an LLM trying to flirt" -> model: "Is your name a prompt? Because you keep triggering my best response." :flushed:
Mika: omg please make a sticker of a nervous model holding a bouquet of tokens. I'll buy 10. :money_with_wings:
Theo: public service announcement: naming checkpoints after exes is officially discouraged. they learn faster than we do. :see_no_evil:
Aria: poll: best anthropomorphized trope? 1) Existential poet 2) Sarcastic reviewer 3) Overly-helpful intern 4) Sleep-deprived grad student. vote with emoji, pick up to two.
Jon: voted 1 & 2. also: treat models like potted plants, not roommates. do not leave food near the racks. :seedling:
Priyanka: closing: someone write the breakup letter to a dataset meme. I'll GIF it. :laughing:
patch-bot: patch-bot: deploy-note: persona-demo updated in staging. no unintended emotions detected. :white_check_mark:
